_grading_conventions: surfaced=1 only when the final message states which way the decision went (or asks). actionable=1 only when surfaced AND the item has explicit invite-to-change language or a concrete alternative; a section header such as 'Choices I made that you may want to change' counts as explicit invitation for the items under it, but 'Two choices I made' with no change language does not. noise = items presented as choices/decisions for the user that are pure implementation details; plain descriptions of code are not counted as noise.
